simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to גָּאַל (H1351) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 11 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: גָּאַל (gâʼal) means to soil or (figuratively) desecrate First listed occurrence: Dan 1 8.

definitions.full: H1351. gaal II. [ גָּאַל ] verb defile , late (compare גָּעַל ) — Niph`al Perfect 3masculine plural נְגֹאֲלוּ Isa 59:3 ; Lam 4:14 , on form see Ges § 51 , 2, Kö i. 265 ; Participle נִגְאָלָה Zeph 3:1 ; — be defiled , hands with blood בַּדָּם , Isa 59:3 compare Lam 4:14 ; participle as substantive defiled, polluted one Zeph 3:1 of Jerusalem (|| מֹרְאָה ; appositive הַיּוֺנָה הָעִיר ). Pi`el Perfect 1plural suffix גֵּאַלְנוּךָ Mal 1:7 pollute, desecrate , object ׳י (desecrated in his altar). Pu`al Imperfect מִןהַֿכְּהֻנָּה וַיְגֹאֲלוּ Ezra 2:62 = Neh 7:64 construct pregnant and they were desecrated out of the priesthood , i.e. deposed, as desecrated one; Participle מְגֹאָל of bread laid on Yahweh's altar Mal 1:7 ; of Yahweh's altar (table, שֻׁלְחָן ) 1:12 . Hiph`il Perfect 1singular אֶגְאָ֑לְתִּי Isa 63:3 (on Aramaic form see Kö i. 27 Ges § 53 R. 6 but) read perhaps גֵּאָ֑לְתִּי Pi`el , see GFM ThLZ 1887, 292 compare also Ges l.c. N. Ol § 255 b Sta § 159 b, 3 ; — I have polluted , i.e. stained all my raiment . Hithpa`el Imperfect יִתְגָּאַל Dan 1:8 ; יִתְגָּאָ֑ל 1:8 ; — defile himself .
definitions.rootNote: a primitive root, (rather identified with 1350 , through the idea of freeing , i.e. repudiating );
